title: Anigosha: Anime Quiz & Duels
shortDescription: Anime quiz with 2,000+ questions: duels, Blitz, Survival, Daily Challenge.
fullDescription:
How well do you really know your series?

Anigosha is a quiz for anime fans: over 2,000 hand-picked questions from
30 popular series, each in three difficulty levels. From beginner
knowledge to details that trip up even seasoned viewers. After every
answer you find out why it was right, so you take something away from
each round, including the ones you get wrong.

PLAY RIGHT AWAY
No email, no sign-up form: tap and play. Want to keep your progress for
good? Secure your account later in your profile.

THREE MODES
• Normal: ten questions at your own pace, with the 50:50 joker.
• Blitz: 60 seconds, as many correct answers as you can.
• Survival: keep going until your three lives are gone.

RIDDLES
"Who am I?" puzzles describe a character clue by clue. The fewer hints
you need, the bigger your bonus. Emoji riddles hide a series behind a
chain of emojis.

DUELS
Turn-based against others: four rounds of three questions, both players
get the same questions. You play when you have time, your opponent plays
when they do. A notification tells you when it's your turn. You can also
challenge your friends directly. While things are still quiet, computer
opponents fill the gap. They are marked as such in the app, and human
players always take priority.

DAILY CHALLENGE
Five questions, new every day, the same for everyone. Plus its own daily
leaderboard, a streak that grows as long as you keep at it, and a result
grid you can share with your friends.

LEVELS, MISSIONS AND LEADERBOARD
Experience points for every round, an Elo rating for every duel, and a
global ranking for everyone. New weekly missions bring bonus XP, and as
you level up you unlock 12 avatars.

ALSO
• 15 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian,
  Indonesian, Turkish, Polish, Vietnamese, Japanese, Korean, Thai,
  Russian and Arabic
• Series names in your own language
• Report incorrect questions, we fix them
• Report and block players
• Ad-supported: a single one-time purchase removes the ads for good

No subscription. No hidden costs.
